Kwikwadrilatera ebhalwe ngaphakathi kwesangqa, isixa sobungakanani beengile ezimbini ezichasayo si-180°. y-m-30-06.topic: Indawo yonxantathu (amacala amabini nengile ephakathi kwawo)
y-m-30-06.goal: Funda ukuba ubude bamacala amabini kuphela abugqibi indawo yonxantathu, hlukanisa ukuba luluphi ulwazi olongezelelweyo olulugqibayo, uze uchaze ukuba kukho onxantathu abanendawo efanayo kodwa bemo ngokwahlukileyo.
y-m-30-06.material: Kunxantathu ABC, uyazi kuphela ukuba AB = 6 cm kunye no-AC = 10 cm, kwaye awukayazi ubungakanani be-∠A. Kuba ngunxantathu, 0° < ∠A < 180°. Indawo ingafunyanwa njenge-½ × AB × AC × sin A ('sin A' ifundwa 'sine A'). Amaxabiso ereferensi: sin 30° = 1/2, sin 60° = (√3)/2 ≈ 0.866, sin 90° = 1, sin 150° = 1/2. I-sine yengile ebanzi ilingana ne-sine yengile ebukhali efunyenwa ngokususa loo ngile kwi-180° (umz., sin 150° = sin 30°).

Ukuba BC = 8, amacala amathathu agqityiwe ngoko unxantathu ugqitywa njengomnye (enyanisweni 6, 8, 10 ngunxantathu one-engile yekona kwi-B, ngoko indawo yi-½×6×8 = 24 cm²), kwaye indawo nayo igqitywa njengexabiso elinye. y-m-30-03.s.s1.reflect: Kwinyathelo loku-1 ubunokuthi uluhlu kuphela, kwaye ulwazi olutsha lwenyathelo lesi-2 lwamisela ixabiso. Hlula ukuba isigqibo sokuqala soluhlu saba 'singalunganga' ngenxa yolwazi olutsha okanye 'sacuthwa'. Jonga umva nokuba kwinyathelo lesi-3 ugwebe ngokwahlula oko kutshintshileyo (ichaphaza lokuchukumisa) koko kungatshintshanga (iimeko ezimisela ubude).
y-m-30-03.s.s2.prompt: Umhlobo wathi, 'PA yi-13 − 5 = 8 cm.' Cacisela lo mhlobo, usebenzisa amanani, ukuba kutheni i-8 cm ingebobude bethanjenti.
y-m-30-03.s.s2.hint.0: Chaza ukuba i-8 cm bubude bantoni, usebenzisa ubudlelwane bendawo phakathi kwechaphaza P nesangqa.
y-m-30-03.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala inkqubo yokufumana i-PA usebenzisa ipropathi yamathanjenti nemo yonxantathu OAP.
y-m-30-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Utshilo ukuba ixabiso 8 limele ntoni (umgama omfutshane kakhulu ukusuka ku-P ukuya kwisangqa)?
y-m-30-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ucacise imo yonxantathu omisela ubude bethanjenti?
y-m-30-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ubonise inkqubo apho inani endilikhethileyo liba yi-12 ngokwenene?
y-m-30-03.s.s2.model.0: 13−5=8 ngumgama osondeleyo ukusuka kwichaphaza P ukuya kwisangqa. Ithanjenti PA ime nkqo kwirediyasi OA, ngoko unxantathu OAP unxantathu one-engile engqukuva kwaye i-hypotenuse yawo yi-OP=13, ngoko PA=12 cm.
y-m-30-03.s.s2.model.1: PA kufuneka ibe ende kune-8. Kunxantathu OAP, ukudibanisa i-5 ne-8 kunika i-13, ngoko unxantathu awenziwa. Kunxantathu one-engile engqukuva, i-13 licala elide kakhulu, ngoko iba yi-12.

y-m-30-07.title: Ingaba umgama phakathi kweekhode ezimbini ezifanayo ugqitywa njengexabiso elinye?
y-m-30-07.goal: Fumana umgama ukusuka embindini ukuya kwikhode, uze ugwebe ubhale ukuba impendulo igqityiwe kuphela xa ucinga zombini imeko apho iikhode ezimbini ezifanayo zisecaleni elinye lembindi nemeko apho zisemacaleni achasayo.
y-m-30-07.material: Kwisangqa O esine-radiyasi ye-13 cm, kukho ikhode AB yobude be-24 cm kunye nekhode CD yobude be-10 cm. Iikhode zombini zifana enye kwenye. Akukho mfanekiso unikiweyo. Ufuna ukufumana umgama phakathi kweekhode ezimbini. (Umgama othe nkqo otsalwa ukusuka embindini wesangqa uye kwikhode wahlula ikhode leyo kubini.)
y-m-30-07.prereq.0: Into yokuba umgama othe nkqo otsalwa ukusuka embindini wesangqa uye kwikhode wahlula ikhode leyo kubini
y-m-30-07.s.s1.prompt: Ikhode nganye ikude kangakanani nombindi O wesangqa?
y-m-30-07.s.s1.hint.0: Chaza ngamagama unxantathu onamaqhosha ayiyo ngcambu yomgama othe nkqo, esinye iziphelo zekhode, nombindi O, uze ufumane apho ikona ekhoyo.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.hint.1: Emva kokugqiba ukuba lelicala lelona lide kuloo nxantathu, bhala intetho efumana elinye icala eliseleyo kubude obubini obaziwayo.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.o.a: 12 cm ukuya ku-AB, 5 cm ukuya ku-CD
y-m-30-07.s.s1.r.a: Usenokuba ucinge ukuba ikhode ide ngakumbi, ikude ngakumbi nombindi. Yenza unxantathu onekona ngesiqingatha sekhode kunye ne-radiyasi ukuhlola.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.o.b: 1 cm ukuya ku-AB, 8 cm ukuya ku-CD
y-m-30-07.s.s1.r.b: Usenokuba uyifumene ngokususa nje isiqingatha sekhode kwi-radiyasi. Hlola ukuba licala elithini i-hypotenuse.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.o.c: 5 cm ukuya ku-AB, 12 cm ukuya ku-CD
y-m-30-07.s.s1.r.c: Lelixabiso elisebenzise into yokuba umgama othe nkqo ukusuka embindini uye kwikhode udlula embindini wekhode.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.o.d: √313 cm ukuya ku-AB, √194 cm ukuya ku-CD
y-m-30-07.s.s1.r.d: Usenokuba udibanise isikwere sesiqingatha sekhode kwisikwere se-radiyasi. Hlola ukuba licala elithini i-hypotenuse.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.explain: Isiphelo somgama othe nkqo ukusuka ku-O ukuya ku-AB sisiphakathi sika-AB, kwaye kunxantathu onekona owenziwe sisiqingatha sobude 12 kunye ne-radiyasi 13, umgama yi-√(13² − 12²) = 5. Kuba CD, isiqingatha sobude si-5, ngoko √(13² − 5²) = 12. Ikhode ide ngakumbi, isondele ngakumbi embindini.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.prompt: Ngezantsi sisisombululo esifumene umgama phakathi kweekhode ezimbini. Khetha umgca onengcinga eyenziwe ngaphandle kwesizathu. Bala amanani emigca ukususela ku-1.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.hint.0: Beka enye yezi phambi komgca ngamnye: 'ibhaliwe kwingxaki / iphume kwisibalo / igqitywe ngumsombululi.'
y-m-30-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ukuba kukho umgca ogqitywe ngumsombululi, vavanya ukuba isiphumo sasiya kutshintsha njani ukuba sasigqitywe ngokwahlukileyo.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.line.0: Umgama ukusuka embindini O ukuya ku-AB yi-5 cm, kwaye umgama ukuya ku-CD yi-12 cm.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.line.1: Iikhode zombini zifana, ngoko imigama ethe nkqo ukusuka ku-O ukuya kwiikhode ezimbini ilala emgceni omnye.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.line.3: Ngoko umgama phakathi kweekhode ezimbini yi-12 − 5 = 7 cm.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.explain: Umgca 3 yingxaki. Ingxaki ayinayo imeko yokuba iikhode ezimbini zisecaleni elinye lika-O, kodwa isisombululo sigqibe oko. Imigca 4 no-5 zizigqibo ezilandela kwesi sithintelo, ngoko umgca onengcinga ebekwe ngaphandle kwesiseko ngumgca 3. Imigca 1 no-2 ichanekile.
y-m-30-07.s.s3.prompt: Zoba imeko apho iikhode ezimbini zisemacaleni achasayo embindi O. Fumana umgama kuloo meko, ubhale ukuba impendulo yale ngxaki kufuneka ibhalwe njani.
y-m-30-07.s.s3.hint.0: Tshintsha ingcinga kumgca 3 wesisombululo uzobe iikhode ezimbini emacaleni achasayo ka-O.
y-m-30-07.s.s3.hint.1: Kuloo meko, bhala ngamagama ukuba udibanisa njani imigama 5 no-12 ukusuka ku-O ukuya kwiikhode ezimbini ukufumana umgama phakathi kweekhode ezimbini.
y-m-30-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uchazile ukuba ufumene njani umgama wamacala achasayo (indlela odibanise ngayo 5 no-12)?
y-m-30-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ubhale zombini icala elifanayo (7 cm) nelicala elichasayo (17 cm) njengeempendulo?
y-m-30-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uchazile isizathu sokuba ngaphandle komfanekiso iindawo azigqitywa?
y-m-30-07.s.s3.model.0: Ukuba zisemacaleni achasayo, yi-5+12=17 cm. Ngoko ukuba iikhode ezimbini zisecaleni elinye lika-O yi-7 cm, kwaye ukuba zisemacaleni achasayo yi-17 cm, kwaye kuba akukho mfanekiso, zombini iimeko, i-7 cm okanye i-17 cm, ziimpendulo.
y-m-30-07.s.s3.model.1: Ukuba u-O ukuphakathi kwazo, dibanisa 5 no-12 ufumane i-17 cm. Ukuba zisecaleni elinye, i-7 cm. Ingxaki ayinayo imeko malunga nendawo, ngoko kufuneka ndibhale ukuba kukho iimpendulo ezimbini (7 cm, 17 cm).

y-m-30-08.title: Intonga ende kakhulu ehlalisa ebhokisini
y-m-30-08.topic: Idayagonali yebhokisi eyirektangile (ukusebenzisa ithiyori kaPythagoras kwiindlela ezintathu)
y-m-30-08.goal: Xa ufumana ubude besegmenti kwisolidi, sebenzisa into yokuba idayagonali yesiseko nokuphakama zenza ikona, yenza iibhokisi apho ubude bedayagonali bulinani lendalo ngeendlela ezininzi, uze ugwebe ukuba intonga ihlala na.
y-m-30-08.material: Kukho ibhokisi eyirektangile engenanto ebanzi ye-3 cm, enzulu ye-4 cm, nephakamileyo ye-12 cm. Ufuna ukubeka intonga ebhityileyo kakhulu engagobi ngokupheleleyo ngaphakathi kule bhokisi. Phoxa ubukhulu bebhokisi, ucinge ukuba imilinganiselo yangaphakathi ifana neyangaphandle. Ufuna ukufumana ubude bentonga ende kakhulu enokungena ngaphakathi kwebhokisi.
y-m-30-08.prereq.1: Ubudlelwane bendawo beencam nobuso bebhokisi eyirektangile (isiseko nokuphakama zithe nkqo)
y-m-30-08.s.s1.prompt: Apha ngezantsi sisisombululo apho umfundi wafumana ubude bentonga ende kakhulu. Khetha umgca omnye ongalunganga. Bala amanani emigca uqala ku-1.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.hint.0: Chaza ngamazwi indlela intonga elala ngayo ithe the ukusuka kumphetho omnye webhokisi ukuya kumphetho ophezulu ochasene, uze ujonge ukuba amanani ama-5 neli-12 kumgca wesi-3 enza i-engile enjani omnye nomnye.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.hint.1: Zoba unxantathu owenziwe ngamacandelo amabini e-5 cm neli-12 cm nentonga. Hlola usebenzisa ubudlelwane phakathi kwamacala onxantathu ukuba ubude bamacala amathathu bunokuba yi-5, 12, 17.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.line.1: Ubude bedayagonali yesiseko yi-3² + 4² = 25, ngoko yi-5.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.line.2: Intonga ilele ngemo edibanisa idayagonali yesiseko i-5 nokuphakama okuli-12, ngoko 5 + 12 = 17.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.line.3: Ngoko eyona ntonga inde yi-17 cm.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.explain: Umgca wesi-3 yingxaki. Intonga idlula ithe the ukusuka kwikona enye yesiseko ukuya kwikona ephezulu echasene, ngoko idayagonali yesiseko (5) nokuphakama (12) kuthe nkqo omnye komnye, yaye intonga yi-hypotenuse kanxantathu othe nkqo onala mabini njengamacala awo. I-hypotenuse asisosixa samacala amabini kodwa yingcambu yesikwere yesixa sezikwere zawo, ngoko ifutshane. Ngoko i-17 cm kumgca wesi-4 nayo ayilunganga. Ibalwe ngokuchanekileyo, √(5² + 12²) = 13 cm.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.prompt: Phakathi kweebhokisi ezinxande apho ububanzi a, ubunzulu b, nokuphakama c zonke ziyinani lemvelo ukusuka ku-1 ukuya kwi-12, yenza iibhokisi ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo apho ubude bentonga ende kakhulu engena ngaphakathi nabo bulinani lemvelo. (Iibhokisi ezi-a, b, c zodwa ngocwangciso olwahlukileyo zibhokisi enye.)
y-m-30-08.s.s2.hint.0: Misela ubude obubini kwabathathu ufumane isikwere sedayagonali yesiseko, uze utshintshe ukuphakama uhlole ukuba isixa sonke siba sisikwere senani elithile na.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.hint.1: Thelekisa iibhokisi owazifumeneyo nesi-3, 4, 12 sokuqala, uzame ngocwangciso uqale kumanani amancinci ngendlela efanayo.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.ok.c1: Ubude obuthathu ngamanani emvelo ukusuka ku-1 ukuya kwi-12.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Ububanzi, ubunzulu, nokuphakama kufuneka zibe ngamanani emvelo ukusuka ku-1 ukuya kwi-12.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Ubude bentonga ende kakhulu bulinani lemvelo.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Ubude bentonga ende kakhulu (ingcambu yesikwere yesixa sezikwere zobude obuthathu) asilonani lemvelo.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo, (1, 2, 2) inika √9 = 3, (2, 3, 6) inika √49 = 7, (4, 4, 7) inika √81 = 9, kwaye (2, 4, 4) inika √36 = 6. Ibhokisi yokuqala (3, 4, 12) inika √169 = 13, ngoko yenye yeebhokisi ezanelisa le meko.
y-m-30-08.s.s3.prompt: Faka intonga kwibhokisi enobubanzi obungu-3, ubunzulu obungu-4, nokuphakama okungu-12. Yeyiphi indlela ehambelana ngayo ubude bentonga nebhokisi? (I-13 cm bubude bentonga ende kakhulu.)
